canary.stop_reason: Case 116 found three cross-category viable cities but its transport collector omitted Provo-to-first-city and last-city-to-Provo ground candidates after endpoint flight searches were empty. The second deterministic validation rejected reconstructed endpoint strings, so the Workflow correctly returned the required empty-plan object. The run was stopped immediately after the non-retryable quality failure.

case_116.runner_error: plan must be a non-empty list
case_116.root_cause: The transport contract required ground alternatives for inter-city pairs but not explicitly for the two origin endpoint legs.

follow_up.strategy: Require a candidate-backed origin endpoint, every inter-city leg, and a candidate-backed return endpoint before a route may be marked feasible; explicitly search both ground modes for endpoint fallback.

notes: No network, authentication, rate-limit, or upstream 5xx error occurred.
The partial full-chain totals include the beginning and cancellation of case 138.
The official evaluator was not run because the strict G2 output/quality gate had already failed.
